scope: Linux host-only FS security, not compiled Atto guest certification

actor_binding.finding: One async FS service previously checked only tenant/generation, allowing accidental reuse of a single actor-scoped broker service across sibling actors when caller supplied another actor identity
actor_binding.fix: Require trusted actor incarnation at creation and immutable exact actor matching on submit, poll, cancellation and forget

local_compilation.caveat: Only source and test match Git blobs; local mock broker header is not the production broker header. This is not a real Linux broker or Atto compiler execution.

token_free_private_mirror.method: GitHub connector fetched each source blob content, verified per-blob SHA, created carrier Git tree with exact root SHA; no secrets, PAT, source checkout token, or cross-org Git authentication
checks: All 235 Git blobs checked against pinned source SHA
Harness is a separate commit with exact source-tree snapshot as its parent
Workflow uses local checkout with persist-credentials false

release_blockers: GitHub Actions runner budget/admission needs an actually stepful run
Mandatory signed artifact and effective ceiling admission into live TenantVM runtime
Trustworthy host-derived actor identity (numeric arguments are never guest credentials)
Actual signed ELF dependency and syscall confinement
Real compiled Atto std.fs positive/negative tests and current-head sanitizer CI
